Scenario fixture: video-captions-track-kind

Each failing target has a stable id of the form vct_case_NN. A video is checked when it has a subtitles or captions track; a track without kind is a subtitles track.

A. Text tracks, none marked as captions (FAIL, or CANTTELL when the subtitles may be translations)

01 — FAIL: kind="subtitles"
02 — FAIL: track without kind
07 — FAIL: subtitles in the page language, and a captions track with no src (delivers nothing)
08 — CANTTELL: only subtitles in another language (may be a translation)

B. Not flagged

03 — PASS: kind="captions"
04 — PASS: subtitles and captions
05 — NEUTRAL: chapters only
06 — NEUTRAL: no track
